acceptance: A recorded reproduction states whether dsqgen Q9 at SF 10000 times out for `tpcds`, `tpcds_obt` or both, and why.
Either query generation succeeds at SF 10000, or the accepted maximum is lowered and a unit test pins the new bound.
context: Filed 2026-11-11 from the benchmark scale-factor audit and the TPC-DS-OBT publication work of 2026-11-10 and 2026-11-11: identified during that work and not addressed.
description:
## Problem
During the TPC-DS-OBT scale runs of 2026-11-10 query generation at SF 10000 and above failed: dsqgen timed out on Q9. The validator accepts values up to 100000 for `tpcds` and `tpcds_obt`, so the command line accepts scale factors at which query generation is known to fail. Whether plain `tpcds` fails the same way was not tested; it uses the same dsqgen.

## Change
Reproduce with dsqgen alone at SF 10000 for Q9, for both benchmarks, and find the cause (the timeout value, or a real hang). Then either fix query generation at that scale or lower the accepted maximum for the two benchmarks and say so in the error message and docs.

## Guardrails
- Query generation only; no data generation at these scales is needed to reproduce.
- A lower maximum is a user-visible change and needs a changelog fragment and the matching site docs edit.
